$comment: Browser capabilities for wasm-bindgen-test-runner. It looks for this file
by name and says so in its output when it is missing.
--no-sandbox is required on CI runners and inside containers, where Chrome
cannot use its usual sandbox and refuses to start. The failure does not say
that: chromedriver simply cannot create a session, dies, and the runner
reports a bare `http status: 404` — the same symptom as a driver/browser
version mismatch, which is what made this confusing. Two different causes,
--disable-dev-shm-usage avoids the small /dev/shm that CI containers give,
which crashes Chrome part-way through a run rather than at startup.
